description: BeatWave 1.4 — fixes the in-app updater (direct APK downloads, no more browser redirect) and consolidates every font control into one place. Plus everything from 1.3: bundled App Fonts, Auto-DJ mixing, a full-screen lyrics overhaul, waveform seeking in the mini player, a redesigned Liquid Glass system, and a large performance pass.

changelog.title: Updates & Fonts (Fixed)
items: In-app updates fixed: the update check now finds BeatWave's actual APK asset and downloads it directly, so Check for updates installs the new version instead of bouncing you to the browser.
All font controls now live in one place — Settings → Appearance → App Font: the App Font picker, the Display font (Chillax wordmark/title) toggle, and the Custom font installer.

changelog.title: App Fonts
items: Pick a bundled typeface for the app's display text: Google Sans, Sans Flex, Outfit, or Plus Jakarta Sans — Settings → Appearance → App Font, with a live typography preview.
Choose System Default to use the system font, or a custom-installed font.

changelog.title: Auto-DJ Mixing (New)
items: Auto-DJ Mixing plays songs back-to-back with tempo-matched crossfades: the incoming song's speed is gently nudged to match the outgoing one while they blend, so the mix stays locked to a beat.

How to use: Settings → Player → turn on Crossfade first, then enable Auto-DJ Mixing. It uses on-device BPM detection (no internet), and falls back to a plain crossfade when a song's tempo can't be detected or is too far off.
A new Auto-DJ section is also surfaced right in the Player layout settings so the feature is easy to find.

changelog.title: Full-Screen Lyrics Overhaul
items: Full-screen lyrics is now a dedicated, ArchiveTune-style presentation you can switch to from the player.
New one-tap flow: Settings → Player → enable One-tap full-screen lyrics and the lyrics button opens/closes full-screen lyrics in a single tap (off keeps the classic two-tap flow).
Player controls now collapse to the top (or bottom, your choice) instead of hiding: Settings → Player → Collapse controls upward.
Playback controls position in full-screen lyrics is toggleable, and the play/pause button can overlay the artwork thumbnail.
Swipe left/right on the artist + song name to change tracks while viewing lyrics.

changelog.title: Player & Mini Player
items: New waveform seek bar in the iOS mini player — drag it to scrub. Toggle under Settings → Player → Mini player waveform seek bar.
Mini bar style toggle: pick the simple thumbnail/seek/play look or the full multi-icon bar (shuffle, prev, play, next, repeat, lyrics, queue). Settings → Player → Multi-icon mini bar.
Mini bar lyrics/queue icons are wired up, codec badge no longer goes stale after a crossfade, and the standalone tab-pill height is properly floored.
New option to hide the volume bar in the player menu (Settings → Player).
Floating pill mini player is now a settings toggle and, on tablets, matches Apple Music's iPad mini-player exactly (width capped in all orientations).

changelog.title: Liquid Glass & Navigation
items: Redesigned Liquid Glass system: glass settings copy on when you enable them, and nav bar vs mini bar now have independent tuning dials (blur, vibrancy, lens).
New per-element overrides for glass color, surface, and text — all under Settings → Liquid Glass.
The side panel gets its own blur/vibrancy/lens tuning, plus a new collapsible tablet sidebar with a smoother collapse animation and fixed pill shape.
The floating pill nav bar is now always on (the old toggle was removed). Restored blur on the nav-bar puck's hidden backdrop row.
In the nav bar there's a new inline search bar — type straight from the floating pill (iOS-style), with a search pill in tab view.

changelog.title: Icons, Themes & Library
items: Full icon set rescraped from Lucide in SF-Symbols style, with the tab bar switched to the Accord icon pack (home/library/group + play/pause/lyrics).
Theme settings overhaul: light-theme audit across screens and new library background modes — Settings → Appearance → Library background.
Pull-to-refresh added to playlists and library lists — just pull down on the list.

changelog.title: Audio Reliability Fixes
items: Fixed downloaded FLAC songs being unplayable when lossless/Spine toggles were on.
Fixed lossless/Atmos audio dropouts — playback now recovers and falls back to standard audio instead of stalling.
Stopped chunk-slicing Tidal/Spine lossless streams, which caused premature auto-skip.
Fixed a crash opening playlists and the Room migration 35→36 crash on upgrade.
No more spurious error reports when a signed-in account's info can't be refreshed after a token change.

changelog.title: Performance
items: Stopped app-wide idle redraw — the UI no longer re-renders when nothing changes.
Glass transitions are much cheaper to run.
Artist/list sorting moved off the main thread; per-item database flows are remembered.
Backdrop record gating, off-main persistence, and coalesced stats writes reduce jank and wake-ups.
